reviews.reason: 这里的 useContext 读取 AssistantClientToolContext，当前 React 19 仍支持该 API；AssistantClientTools 提供 clientTools 和 refresh 注册 owner，useAssistantRefreshTarget 返回注册的清理函数。该诊断不证明 API 已移除；替换为 use 不修复现有行为。 P17b reassessed 2026-11-17: The changed workflow application fixture only adds the backend analysis envelope. AssistantClientToolProvider still supplies the context and unregisters the matching refresh callback; the context hook itself is unchanged.
